summary: Check site access for a list of emails
description:
Returns the list of emails from the input list that do not have access to site.

**[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**:
Permission to access the Confluence site ('Can use' global permission).

200.description: Returns object with list of emails without access to site.

emailsWithoutAccess.description: List of emails that do not have access to site.

invalidEmails.description: List of invalid emails provided in the request.

400.description: Returned if an invalid request is provided.

401.description:
Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing
from the request.

404.description: Returned if the calling user does not have permission to check access for emails on site.

503.description: Returned if API is disabled on site
